conclusion: The accepted frame callback 0x82E87D18 reaches broad driver 0x82C7DF58, which has a bounded virtual-dispatch-to-0x82C71A00 edge; that caller contains three static 0x82C71880 helper callsites. Manifest RVA-F-0262 adds conditional receiver/vtable relations from that frame path to both 0x8250F988 and 0x8250AC90, with the +0x15C sibling dispatch preceding the first +0x160 call and a second +0x160 call later in the same bounded frame body. Manifest RVA-F-0265 further maps the nonzero +0x98 arm's selected frame-owner pointer through DD0 to F988's incoming r4 and its guarded +0x550 store; the pre-store +0x74/+0x78 provider path and later current-+0x550 group-slot selection are separate bounded stages, and equality between the incoming pointer and later group values remains conditional across intervening returns, field retention, storage validity, aliasing, and vptr state. Both renderer relations require the global to retain the same object initialized by 0x8250F0E8 with vptr 0x82047050 and satisfy their explicit field/helper predicates; bounded reset stores and historical captures do not prove retention or a unique global type. The alternate-tiling arm contains sibling setup and end callsites from 0x82C71880: setup at 0x82C71900 reaches ClearF and the clear emitter, then conditional on setup return the same helper calls end at 0x82C71944; end contains replay and state cleanup without a direct Resolve callsite in its bounded body. Independently, renderer-table method 0x8250F988 has a static BeginTiling callsite under a count guard and dynamic draw/state callback callsites, while 0x8250AC90 has guarded static depth then indexed-color Resolve callsites under per-tile predication, clears predication, and has an EndTiling callsite with null resolve arguments. ClearF target defaults, the Resolve provider-output path, and sibling pre-swap-before-VdSwap calls are exact bounded facts. The two renderer relations, clear, resolve, and presentation fragments have no total order beyond the bounded local frame order, concrete target/depth surfaces and EDRAM bases are unknown, execution counts and cadence remain unresolved, and the total world-pass hierarchy remains open.
